sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

I am writing to follow up on my previous message, as we have not yet received your reply. For generations, our foundry has taken immense pride in supplying high-quality castings to trusted partners in our region. We stand by our fair offer of €50.90 and are keeping it open for you.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. To recap the details, our offer stands at a price of €50.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Please let us know your decision so we can conclude this agreement and focus on our continued partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We are delighted to accept your terms and look forward to receiving your official order. For our records, our Angebot stands at a price of €51.84 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 14 days.

It is always a pleasure to work together, reflecting the strong bond our companies share.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

Over the years, our foundry has always valued the long relationship and strong ties we share within our region. However, after careful consideration, we must inform you that we are withdrawing from this negotiation. We wish Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH all the very best for the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

I noticed that your latest proposed price is higher than our previous offer of €50.90, which I assume was a clerical error.

I am confident that we can conclude our agreement at this fair price, which reflects the traditional high quality of our foundry.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
